title: Couple on Rocky Coastline of 17-Mile Drive, 1973 California B&W Snapshot Photo
location: 17-Mile Drive, Monterey Peninsula, California, United States
description: A man named Phil and a long-haired young woman pose on rugged granite boulders along the 17-Mile Drive coastline in Monterey, California, in January 1973. Behind them, heavy ocean waves crash beneath an open sky, capturing typical early 1970s scenic road-trip tourism.
